name: Shirayuki Fubuki
source:
Fubuki, Hime's younger brother, is a tiny, white critter who follows Yukinoshin around like a loyal pup. He's undergoing intense training and working his tail off to become a top-notch Yuki-otoko (Snowman). Calling Fubuki "cute" ticks him off—though he's indeed the spitting image of an adorable pet.

"Squeak, squeak!"
